threshold_method.description: Two-sided baseline envelope using median ± 6 robust sigma, expanded to include the 0.5th and 99.5th baseline quantiles.
threshold_method.fallback: Sample standard deviation, minimum 1 microsecond, when robust sigma is below 1 microsecond.

deployment_warning: These limits characterize the authorized reference tag. Do not claim clone/emulator detection accuracy until an actual comparison device has been tested.
